transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um, well, I guess what brings me in is that I just can't seem to shake this feeling that I've ruined things for everyone. I've been falling behind at work, and... I've kind of lost control of the apartment situation. It just feels like I deserve whatever bad thing happens to me next.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Most days, um, I just wake up with this flat, heavy sadness. It's just kind of there. And as for losing interest... yeah. The things that usually kind of reset me, like putting on a record, cooking, or just tinkering with some electronics... they just don't really reach me anymore. I don't get anything out of them right now.
How long have you been feeling this way most days?

It's been going on for about a year and two months now. It really started right after a pipe burst at my old place, which forced me to move into this smaller apartment. Once that happened, my normal routines just kind of fell apart, and I've been feeling like this ever since.
Have you ever experienced any periods where your mood felt unusually elevated or you had more energy than usual, even for a short time?
No, I haven't. I've never really had a time where I felt super energetic or like my mood was up. It's pretty much just been this heavy feeling the whole time.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over the past year?
No, not really. My appetite has been about the same as usual, and I haven't noticed any major changes in my weight.
Have you had any trouble sleeping or noticed that you're sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah, definitely having trouble sleeping. I'll usually just... lie there in bed for hours, mostly just listening for noises in the apartment. When I finally do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way before dawn. I just wake up feeling already tense and exhausted, kind of like I never really powered down for the night.
Have you felt like you were a failure or that you’ve let others down more than once in the past year?

Yeah, a lot. Actually, that's kind of a big part of why I'm here. I just can't shake this feeling that I've... I don't know, ruined things for everyone. I've been falling so far behind at work, and I've completely lost control of the situation at the apartment. It just feels like I'm a massive failure and that I deserve whatever bad thing is going to happen to me next.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living or had thoughts about harming yourself?

I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I do catch myself thinking sometimes that it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. Like, if I just wasn't here, nobody would have to deal with me or the mess I've made anymore.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you didn’t feel this way, even a little bit?

No, I haven't. It's been pretty constant. This has all been going on for about a year and two months now, actually. It started ever since a pipe burst and forced me to move into this smaller apartment... and my routines just completely fell apart after that. So, no, I haven't had a break from feeling this way since then.
Was the pipe bursting and having to move into a smaller apartment a particularly stressful event for you at the time?

Yeah, it really was. I mean... having to deal with the water damage and then suddenly packing up and moving everything into a space where it barely fits... it was incredibly stressful. It just completely upended my life, and I never really got back on track after that.

Before this past year and two months, have you ever had a period of feeling down or losing interest in things that lasted for at least two weeks, and was separated by at least two months where you felt back to normal?
No, I don't think so. Before the move, I felt fine. I mean, I had bad days like anyone else, but nothing like this, and definitely nothing that lasted for weeks on end.

Before the period that started after the pipe burst, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then later felt back to normal for at least two months before that happened again?

No, like I just mentioned, I really haven't. Before the pipe burst and the move, everything was fine. I never had any periods where I felt down or lost interest in things for weeks at a time before all this started.

Before the period that started after the pipe burst, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, and then later felt back to normal for at least two months before that happened again?

Uh, I think you might have just asked me that. But no, I haven't. Like I said a second ago, before the pipe burst and the move, I was totally fine. I've never had a stretch of feeling down or losing interest like this in the past. This is the first time.
Before the period that started after the pipe burst, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, even if it was a long time ago?

I'm... pretty sure you just asked me that again. But yeah, the answer is still no. Even a long time ago, I never went through anything like this. Before the pipe burst, everything in my life was completely normal.
